name: Temperance Pringle
bioAdditions: FamilySearch attaches an Ohio death record (1908-1953) of a Sarah Lydia Castner that names 'Temperance Pringle' as her mother (S1). This is a daughter of Temperance and Clark S. Davenport from the couple's Ohio years, and it independently confirms Temperance's maiden name. The household is in the 1850 and 1860 censuses (S1).
